title: SHMA server data pack
description: The data pack's name and design can be changed and adapted to your server.
body:
Adds 14 new achievements and a mechanic with a renamed diamond ore—"Шмакс" (diamond ore from deep shale). Completing achievements rewards crafting recipes, experience depending on the difficulty, and, in some cases, Shmaks. Crafting recipes for light sources have been added for levels 15, 12, 10, 8, and 5. The data pack's name and design can be changed and adapted to your server.

The data pack's name and design can be changed and adapted to your server.
A startup message is present upon login with a link to Discord (replaced with the author's server), which can be disabled upon re-login or enabled with the command /trigger sendstartmess set 1.
